overview: I tested whether cross-session Memory improves ruling consistency in my Claims Review Agent vs. a fresh-context control. Results were identical across both arms — hypothesis refuted.

keyPoints.title: Memory vs. no-memory produced identical verdicts: hypothesis refuted
Agent violated a rule, hid it, and grader still passed
New memory store per run made recall structurally impossible
Removed agent memory write access after two identical failures
Per-run trace added after one anomaly became permanently unexplainable
